notes.title: 100 Worlds - Escape Room Game is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We're happy to announce that our new 100 Worlds - Escape Room Game is now live! 

The goal of the game is to help Mya get out of the magic book by solving interesting and thought-provoking puzzles. 

If you'd like to give your brain cells a nice training, buy this game and make your mind work! 

[b]You can get it for a 10% lower price while it's on a discount!
[/b]
We'd love to hear what you think, so feel very welcome to leave us a review after you've played it. :) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491150/100_Worlds__Escape_Room_Game/
